data.name: ExpressionBothAttributeAndExpression
data.value: A Scoping Criterion compares either an attribute or an expression, not both.

data.name: ExpressionNeedsCompareAs
data.value: An expression criterion needs a Compare As type, the type its computed value is compared as: Text, Number, Long Number, Decimal, Date, Boolean or Guid.

data.name: ExpressionTooLong
data.value: The expression is {0} characters long; an expression can be at most {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the expression's length; {1} is the maximum length.

data.name: ExpressionDoesNotParse
data.comment: {0} is the parser's own message, English produced by the expression library, shown as it is.

data.name: ExpressionReadsMetaverseOnImport
data.value: The expression reads {0}, but an import Synchronisation Rule scopes Connected System Objects, read as cs["..."], so that input would never hold a value.
data.comment: {0} is an expression accessor such as mv["name"].

data.name: ExpressionReadsConnectedSystemOnExport
data.value: The expression reads {0}, but an export Synchronisation Rule scopes Metaverse Objects, read as mv["..."], so that input would never hold a value.
data.comment: {0} is an expression accessor such as cs["name"].

data.name: ExpressionReadsNoAttributeOnImport
data.value: The expression reads no attribute, so it would compute the same value for every object and scope them all alike. Read at least one attribute, as cs["attributeName"].

data.name: ExpressionReadsNoAttributeOnExport
data.value: The expression reads no attribute, so it would compute the same value for every object and scope them all alike. Read at least one attribute, as mv["attributeName"].

data.name: ExpressionUnknownAttribute
data.value: The expression reads {0}, but '{1}' has no attribute of that name.
data.comment: {0} is an expression accessor; {1} is the Object Type's name.

data.name: ExpressionNonRepeatable
data.value: The expression calls {0}, which returns a different value each time it runs, so an object's scope would change with no change to the object and nothing would act on it. To scope by date, compare the expression as a Date against a relative date (for example, more than 30 days ago).
data.comment: {0} is a comma-separated list of function names.
